title: Learn Numbers and Time Basics
summary: Learn and recognize the Kreyòl numbers from one through twenty in useful spoken and written forms.

sketchBlocks.title: youn, de, twa…
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Start with the first ten numbers:

1 **youn** · 2 **de** · 3 **twa** · 4 **kat** · 5 **senk**

6 **sis** · 7 **sèt** · 8 **wit** · 9 **nèf** · 10 **dis**

Say them aloud in small groups rather than trying to memorize the whole list at once.

sketchBlocks.title: de liv, twa valiz
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Numbers can go directly before a noun:

- **de liv** — two books
- **twa valiz** — three bags
- **senk kaye** — five notebooks

This prepares you for quantities, time, prices, and everyday counting.
